snippet.description:
Official music vide of 'Fairytale of New York' performed by Hozier & Jessie Buckley.

Listen to '20th Century Paddy - The Songs of Shane MacGowan' now: https://found.ee/20thcenturypaddy

Lyrics:
It was Christmas Eve, babe
In the drunk tank
An old man said to me
"Won't see another one"
And then he sang a song
"The Rare Old Mountain Dew"
I turned my face away
And dreamed about you
Got on a lucky one
Came in eighteen-to-one
I've got a feeling
This year's for me and you
So happy Christmas
I love you, baby
I can see a better time
When all our dreams come true

They've got cars big as bars, they've got rivers of gold
But the wind goes right through you, it's no place for the old
When you first took my hand on a cold Christmas Eve
You promised me Broadway was waiting for me

You were handsome, you were pretty, queen of New York City
When the band finished playing, they howled out for more
Sinatra was swinging, all the drunks, they were singing
We kissed on a corner, then danced through the night

The boys of the NYPD choir were singing "Galway Bay"
And the bells were ringing out for Christmas Day

You're a bum, you're a punk, you're an old hag on junk
Lying there almost dead on a drip in that bed
You scumbag, you maggot, you cheap, lousy blaggard
Happy Christmas, your arse, I pray God it's our last

The boys of the NYPD choir, still singing "Galway Bay"
And the bells are ringing out for Christmas Day

"I could have been someone", well, so could anyone
You took my dreams from me when I first found you
I kept them with me, babe, I put them with my own
Can't make it all alone, I've built my dreams around you

The boys of the NYPD choir, still singing "Galway Bay"
And the bells are ringing out for Christmas Day

The boys of the NYPD choir, still singing "Galway Bay"
And the bells are ringing out
And the bells are ringing out
And the bells are ringing out for Christmas Day

#Challa #SatinderSartaaj

It captures how the presence of one person can make an ordinary moment feel blessed, bring light into the darkest days, and turn the simplest memories into something unforgettable.

The music video follows the story of a photographer in search of the perfect picture, only to discover that sometimes, the most beautiful ending is the one you never planned for.

snippet.title: Half Alive (From The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping - The Album) (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
Official Music Video for "Half Alive." 

Listen to "Half Alive" here: https://TheHungerGames.lnk.to/HalfAlive
Listen to The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping (The Album) here: https://www.hungergamessoundtrack.com/

Subscribe to Mckenna's channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCljX1tdPl0cVS17OQzzflWQ?sub_confirmation=1

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@mckennagrace?lang=en
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mckennagraceful/?hl=en
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MckennaGraceful
Website: https://www.mckennagrace.com/

Lyrics:

I clean the floor with all the tears left here before me 
Diggin’ my heels into the dirt, won’t fall to my knees  
And all the vultures who want me dead say they adore me 
I’m scared to sleep cause so much changes by the morning 
I’m barely holding on 

My finest ribbons on as I walk to the gallows 
I try but I’m defined by all that I can’t let go 
So call me vile, cruel and bad like I’m an animal 
Tell me to beg and bare my teeth like some sick joke 
Watch as the man plays God 

Won’t hang my head, won’t plead for my life 
They’ll leave me here broken, so just stay by my side 
We feel the unspoken, the look in your eyes 
Promise you’ll hold me, when I’m half alive 
  
I was a sister once, I carry that love closely  
Somehow it haunts me where I go  like that role chose me 
I say I’m mean and tough and I don’t care ‘cause I’m not weak 
But if tomorrow was my last, hope someone mourns me 
Watch as they all applaud 

Won’t hang my head, won't plead for my life 
They’ll leave me here broken so just stay by my side 
We feel the unspoken, the look in your eyes 
Promise you’ll hold me when I’m half alive 

Nobody cares or knows you ‘til you’re just a body 
I fought I pulled away but you, you always saw me 
You’re bruised and bloody, and I’m trying to act softly  
Oh I’m … half alive 

Promise you’ll hold me when I’m half alive 

#MckennaGrace #HungerGames #SunriseontheReaping

Deep atmospheric melodies, hypnotic rhythms, and soulful vocals create a powerful night drive experience. Sometimes the greatest growth happens in silence, when there's nothing left to prove and everything left to become.

Close your eyes, feel the music, and let the silence speak.

🎧 Best experienced with headphones.

snippet.title: Daddy Yankee  en vivo Premio Latin GRAMMY 2026
snippet.description:
Daddy Yankee  en vivo Premio Latin GRAMMY 2026



Daddy Yankee protagonizó uno de los momentos más memorables de los Latin GRAMMY 2026 con una presentación histórica en honor a su reconocimiento como Persona del Año. En un espectacular medley de diez canciones, El Big Boss recorrió los grandes éxitos que marcaron su trayectoria y transformaron la música global, acompañado por invitados especiales como Bizarrap, LL Cool J, Jay Wheeler, Fresh Montana, Bad Gyal, Feid y la superestrella india Diljit Dosanjh. Jay Wheeler interpretó “Ella Me Levantó”, mientras Fresh Montana se sumó a “Con Calma”. Desde “Dura”, “Despacito” y “Gasolina” hasta “POKITO”, su más reciente colaboración, la presentación conectó generaciones, culturas y mercados, reafirmando la vigencia de su legado y su influencia en la música mundial. Una noche que rindió homenaje a quien no solo hizo historia en el reggaetón, sino que continúa escribiendo su próximo capítulo

snippet.title: Firearms Expert Reacts to SULFUR Guns | EXP
snippet.description:
EXP is the premium destination for your favourite expert-driven content, all funded by the fans. Get early access and extended episodes every week at: https://Patreon.com/WatchEXP

EXP Merch is available now! Go to https://expvideo.info to check out our Cursed and Core Collection, including T-Shirts, Hoodies, Pint Glasses, Posters, and Stickers!

Jonathan Ferguson, an expert in firearms history, and the Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries Museum in the UK, reacts to the utterly unhinged weapons of SULFUR, including the Ferryman ‘Anti-Materiel SMG’, the Arbiter 2 triple-barreled sawed-off shotgun and an LMG with the most painful reload animation we’ve ever seen.

Shout-out to Donkquad for the thumbnail art! 

00:00 - Intro
01:22 - P38 Dirk
03:27 - Mossman
05:07 - Chat-Pardeur 98
07:42 - Arbiter 2
10:21 - Nightlily 318
11:57 - Ripox Mowlock
15:34 - Why not check out our Patreon?
16:06 - Impala Gravita
17:20 - Flicker
18:30 - Ferryman
20:01 - Salamander
22:36 - Termite
24:28 - Neuraxis F22
27:10 - Breacher 8
29:08 - M11A2 Fisk

In this episode of Expert Reacts on EXP, Jonathan Ferguson--an expert in firearms history and the Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries Museum in the UK--breaks down the guns of SULFUR, and compares them to their real-life counterparts with artefacts from the Royal Armouries archive.

If you're interested in seeing more of Jonathan's work, you can check out more from the Royal Armouries right here. - https://www.youtube.com/user/RoyalArmouries  

If you would like to support the Royal Armouries, you can make a charitable donation to the museum here. - https://royalarmouries.org/support-us/donate

And if you would like to become a member of the Royal Armouries, you can get a membership here. - https://royalarmouries.org/support-us/become-a-member

You can purchase Jonathan's book here. - https://www.headstamppublishing.com/bullpup-rifle-book

You can subscribe to the Armax Journal that Jonathan Associate Edited here: https://www.armaxjournal.org/

snippet.title: The Microscopic Defect That Paralysed this Sega Saturn!

In this video, we're going to tackle an eBay "spares or repair" Sega Saturn I bought about 3 years ago.

Join me as we tear down the console, clean up corrosion from a past liquid spill, inspect the PCB under high magnification, and track down the microscopic defect that completely paralysed this retro console. Once repaired, we reassemble the unit and test it out with some classic Sega Rally Championship!

If you enjoy retro console repairs, electronics diagnostics, and bringing vintage tech back to life, please give the video a thumbs up and consider subscribing for more repair projects!

Got questions, thoughts, or Sega Saturn memories? Drop them in the comments below!

The creators of Roblox's 'Croydon London Bus Simulator' have just released a brand new game; this time taking us under the streets of London!

Welcome to Underground: Victoria, Centro's brand new title that was released on the 14th of November 2026. This game accurately recreates the entirety of London's Victoria line, with 16 stations across 21km of track, taking just over 30 minutes to drive! But does it live up to the hype?

This game first made an appearance over three years ago - but has Centro created the game we were all looking forward too? It's time to find out. Sit back, relax, and enjoy our full overview into Underground: Victoria!

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community. ROBLOX is designed for 13 to 18 year olds, but it is open to people of all ages. Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.description:
GTA 6 just keeps getting more realistic! New GTA 6 photo-realistic gameplay footage has surfaced, along with brand-new screenshots, the reveal of the in-game Macca TV show, and even more incredible details about Rockstar Games' massive open world.

0:00 New Game Update
01:30 Macca & Friends Tv Show Trailer
04:24 New GTA 6 Gameplay
07:38 New GTA 6 Screenshots, Hurricanes,Dolphins & Stories Info.

Source for Rusty Anchor :
&utm_medium=ios_app&utm_name=iossmf&utm_source=share&utm_term=1

In today's video, we're breaking down the latest Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay clips, analyzing the stunning graphics and realistic environments, taking a closer look at the newly revealed Macca TV show, and exploring hidden details spotted in the latest GTA 6 screenshots.

From the incredible level of realism to the immersive world of Vice City and Leonida, Rockstar Games continues to push the boundaries of what we can expect from GTA 6.
